files.AGENTS.md: The rules of this workspace: structure, boundaries, the standard.
files.contract.md: The pointer to the public standard and the local exceptions.
files.opencode.json: MCP servers, skills path, permissions and the model policy. No secrets.

repos.text: Projects with their own git history and their own remote. They are cloned by bootstrap/restore.sh and are not part of the workspace repository.

mcps.role: runtime and rules of the MCP servers
mcps.text: The servers that reach Paperless, Home Assistant and the two hosts over SSH, plus diary and GitHub. Only what belongs to this machine is here; the code lives in its project.

skills.text: Knowledge about a tool or a procedure, loaded on demand. The folder is not published as it is: several skills name this machine's services.

configs.role: this machine's rules for tools from repos/
configs.text: The concrete window layout, the real tile list. Not public: it is this machine's configuration, not the tool's capability.

bootstrap.role: how this machine is rebuilt from GitHub
bootstrap.text: restore.sh clones the projects, repos.txt is the only list of their names. Published.

models.text: GGUF files for the local llama.cpp server. Not versioned, not published, and no agent names them any more.

secrets.text: Closed to the agent by configuration. Only its existence is named here, never its content — not even the file names.

backups.text: Closed to the agent by configuration. Existence only, for the same reason as secrets/.

scratch.text: What lies here is deleted, not maintained. The folder may be absent.

repos.basic-apps: This page: the public state of the workspace, generated from the folder tree.
repos.basic-specs: The versioned standard: rules, profiles, checker, specimen and the public registry.
repos.app-template: The vanilla static starter with Lorem Ipsum, tests and a green check.
repos.diary: Dated entries in SQLite, readable and searchable in the browser; an AI may only append.
repos.die-wand: A wall of bookmark tiles, static, no account, no cloud.

filmchen.text: Turns a folder of numbered pictures, clips, narration and pauses into one MP4.

repos.four-wins: Connect Four in Angular, live on GitHub Pages.
repos.startup-layout: A GNOME Shell extension that builds the window layout at login.
repos.mycents: A local-first personal finance ledger for accounts, neutral transfers, recurring routines and yearly comparison.
